headline: Helen Haines has lost both legs after alleged attack but ‘her heart and mind are in good shape’, husband says
body_markdown:
Haines is in stable condition. Surgeons tried to save her right leg but both have now been amputated due to injuries Get our new political email, free app or daily news podcast The independent MP Helen Haines has lost both legs but remains in a stable condition, two days after an alleged targeted attack near her electorate office in north-east Victoria. Haines, the federal MP for Indi, had been in a critical but stable condition after she was struck by a car in Wangaratta on Monday afternoon. (The Guardian Australia)

**MyJoyOnline** adds: Helen Haines, the Australian MP who was hit by a car in what authorities say was a deliberate attack, has lost both her legs, her husband has confirmed. Phil Haines said the “horrendous incident” caused his wife significant injuries but “her heart and her mind are in good shape”.

**Deutsche Welle** adds: Doctors have amputated both of Helen Haines legs after the Australian lawmaker was hit in an apparent deliberate attack. The suspected driver involved in the attack has appeared in court.
